"""Isolated optimizer experiment; same inputs and acceptance constraints."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'hw/soc/pnr'))
from interface_flow import Interfaces, BoundedPostGRT
from librelane.flows import Flow

class Repairs4PostGRT(BoundedPostGRT):
    def get_script_path(self):
        original=Path(super().get_script_path())
        source=original.read_text()
        anchor='lappend setup_args -max_iterations 600\n'
        assert source.count(anchor)==1
        source=source.replace(anchor,'lappend setup_args -max_iterations 120\nlappend setup_args -max_repairs_per_pass 4\n')
        output=Path(self.step_dir)/'repairs4_setup.tcl'
        output.write_text(source)
        return str(output)

@Flow.factory.register()
class Repairs4Experiment(Interfaces):
    Steps=[Repairs4PostGRT if s.id=='OpenROAD.ResizerTimingPostGRT' else s for s in Interfaces.Steps]

if __name__=='__main__':
    from librelane.__main__ import cli
    cli()
